moves.description: Removes all status conditions from an ally.

moves.name:
Baby Blue
Play Rough
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any move once.
Deactivation Condition: When this move is used.

Never misses. Has a chance (10%) of lowering the target’s Attack by one stat rank. The power and chance of applying additional effects of this move are not lowered even if there are multiple targets. If the remaining MP for the user’s Lum Berry is one or more when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by one and grants all of the following effects: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks. Applies Sinnoh Circle (Physical) to the allied field of play. Sinnoh Circle (Physical) grants all of the following effects: Powers up the physical attack moves and physical sync moves of all allied sync pairs by 10%. Reduces physical attack move and physical sync move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by 5%. The more sync pairs with the Sinnoh theme that are on the allied field of play, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves and sync moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is 40%, and the maximum damage reduction is 14%.)

moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by one. Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s accuracy by 1 stat rank. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks.
